question: Why was the completed, gate-PASSed F-3B disposition (v58 ordered work 1, producer run 39287274485) never promoted to lab/evaluation, and what must a resume cycle do to make the snapshot audit-ready?
verdict: ORCHESTRATION_FAILURE_NOT_LANE_WORK_FAILURE — the F-3B disposition work is complete and correct on the snapshot; three consecutive runs (39287274485, 39294126962, 39296616437) failed to close the team->audit->integrate chain because NO AUDIT BRANCH was ever created for any of them, so the workflow gate reader never found a CYCLE_<run_id>_GATE.json at the audit-ref path for the run being integrated, and integrate never fired. The PASS gate for 39287274485 that DOES exist was written into the TEAM branch by the subsequent run 39294126962's producer commit (c61f36c2), not onto an audit branch by an independent audit job — team-branch placement is invisible to the integrate job's audit-branch checkout (core-lane.yml integrate step: git checkout origin/$AUD -- results/audit/$LANE reports/audit/$LANE).

run_chain.role: producer of the F-3B disposition (v58 ordered work 1)
run_chain.work: evaluation/f3b_restore_disposition.py, results/evaluation/f3b_restore_disposition/39287274485.json, restore of 39164900837.json to 58a273de..., re-home 39164900837_post-restore-9b61dcf8.json, tests (10+10+24+6 PASS per later verification)

run_chain.role: repair round; producer commit carried the PREVIOUS run's gate onto the TEAM branch
run_chain.work: reports/evaluation/CYCLE_39287274485_VERIFICATION.md + results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_39287274485_GATE.json (gate=PASS, safe_to_integrate=true, run_id=39287274485) committed ON THE TEAM BRANCH under commit message 'evaluation cycle 39294126962 repair 0'

run_chain.role: re-dispatch; producer produced ZERO delta (this resume's named snapshot)

lab_evaluation_tip.note: the F-3B disposition of run 39287274485 is NOT on lab/evaluation; the lane's state/evaluation.json on the snapshot claims accepted_run_id=39287274485, which is PROPOSED (audit gate PASS exists) but NOT YET PROMOTED — promotion is exactly what this resume run's independent audit+integrate chain must complete.

mechanism.gate_reader_contract: factory-wide requirement 1: the audit job runs jq -e '.gate=="PASS" or ...' results/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_GATE.json against the AUDIT JOB CHECKOUT; integrate then checks out origin/$AUD -- results/audit/$LANE reports/audit/$LANE and merges into the lab branch only when that gate says PASS with safe_to_integrate=true (core-lane.yml lines ~229-252).
mechanism.why_team_placement_is_invisible: the integrate job's audit checkout is the AUDIT branch (cycle/core/evaluation/<run>/audit), not the team branch; a gate file that exists only on the team branch is never read by integrate for that run id.
mechanism.why_no_audit_branch: the audit jobs of 39287274485, 39294126962 and 39296616437 each died or were skipped before pushing cycle/core/evaluation/<run>/audit (no such ref exists on origin for any of the three; git ls-remote/branch inventory confirms). The precise death cause per run is NOT observable from the repository alone (job logs are the authority; this artifact claims only the observable repository fact: no audit ref, no lab promotion).
mechanism.zero_delta_run: 39296616437 produced no commit beyond 39294126962's tip; under factory-wide requirement (rc-67 LEX_ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR) a zero-delta repair round is expected to exit 67 and re-dispatch, which matches the observed re-dispatch pattern to this resume run 39297074815.

independent_content_verification_by_this.note: The resume cycle re-derived the F-3B chain content itself, so the team-branch gate's PASS claim does not rest on the unpushed audit alone:
independent_content_verification_by_this.git_blob_rederivation: git rev-parse 688321db:results/evaluation/frozen_cache_integrity/39164900837.json => blob 6a5ed68ff1cb0b51927b0360a4cc7a0962fc7649 (matches the pinned preimage)
independent_content_verification_by_this.frozen_four_rehash: all four match pinned digests (see freeze record evaluation/V58_OPERATIONAL_RESUME_HYPOTHESIS_V1.json)
independent_content_verification_by_this.pytest_targeted: 49 passed / 1 failed (the stale escalation-source absence test) on the pre-repair snapshot; the failure is the KNOWN probe-ref-coverage artifact documented in results/evaluation/f3b_escalation_source_correction/39297074815.json, not an F-3B work defect

snapshot_defects_found_and_repaired_this.defect: tests/evaluation/test_f3b_record_adjudication.py::test_cited_escalation_source_is_proven_absent asserts the cited escalation gate is absent from every ref; the full-fetch environment finds it at refs/remotes/origin/cycle/core/evaluation/39199651952/audit (commit 97894bba, 2026-10-19T04:39:18Z, gate=REVISE with F-3b escalate). The historical absence was a probe ref-coverage artifact: the core-lane CI checkout fetches only the CURRENT run's team/audit refs plus lab branches (core-lane.yml team job lines 42-64, audit job lines 171-182), so historical cycle audit refs are invisible there.
snapshot_defects_found_and_repaired_this.repair: test replaced by a dual-pin test: the accepted adjudication record's historical finding stays pinned byte-exact; the live probe result is asserted with environment-honest semantics (content pin when the audit ref is present, explicit skip naming the missing ref otherwise). Correction artifact: results/evaluation/f3b_escalation_source_correction/39297074815.json. The accepted record results/evaluation/f3b_adjudication/39225862749.json is NOT modified.

snapshot_defects_found_and_repaired_this.defect: state/evaluation.json evidence_refs contains a CORRECTION_39231573047 prose note that is not a file path, failing tests/evaluation/test_audit_correction_verification.py::test_evidence_refs_exist.
snapshot_defects_found_and_repaired_this.repair: the note text is moved VERBATIM into a sibling field evidence_ref_corrections; evidence_refs now contains only existing file paths; the new correction and diagnosis artifacts are added as refs.

snapshot_defects_found_and_repaired_this.defect: reports/evaluation/CYCLE_39287274485.md is cited in state.evidence_refs but does not exist in the tree (the cycle wrote CYCLE_39287274485_VERIFICATION.md instead, on the later team commit).
snapshot_defects_found_and_repaired_this.repair: the missing report-of-record is written, clearly attributed as authored by resume run 39297074815 completing cycle 39287274485's report obligation; its content re-derives only from committed artifacts.

claim_ceiling: This artifact claims only the repository-observable diagnosis above and the repairs listed. It does NOT claim the audit jobs' internal death causes (job logs are the authority), does NOT certify any frozen absolute bar, does NOT unblock human_gate_ready/machine_gate_ready/packet_admitted/ready_for_owner_session (all stay false), and authorises no owner question (owner_decision_required stays false). Both DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand unchanged.
